-- customer retention analysis


SELECT
    customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders,
    SUM(total_spend) AS total_spend,
    AVG(total_spend) AS average_customer_spend
FROM dbo.customer_segmentation
GROUP BY customer_segment
ORDER BY total_spend DESC;


-- best customer retention opportunity

SELECT
    customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN total_orders = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS customers_never_purchased,
    SUM(CASE WHEN total_orders > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS customers_with_orders,
    SUM(total_spend) AS total_historical_spend
FROM dbo.customer_segmentation
GROUP BY customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;



-- Sales performance analysis

SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM dbo.daily_sales
ORDER BY 1 DESC;


SELECT COLUMN_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo'
  AND TABLE_NAME = 'daily_sales'
ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION;


SELECT TOP 10
    sales_date,
    total_orders,
    total_items,
    gross_sales,
    total_discount,
    total_tax,
    net_sales,
    average_order_value
FROM dbo.daily_sales
ORDER BY net_sales DESC;


-- Monthly sales trend

SELECT
    YEAR(sales_date) AS sales_year,
    MONTH(sales_date) AS sales_month,
    SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders,
    SUM(total_items) AS total_items,
    SUM(gross_sales) AS gross_sales,
    SUM(total_discount) AS total_discount,
    SUM(total_tax) AS total_tax,
    SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales,
    AVG(average_order_value) AS average_daily_order_value
FROM dbo.daily_sales
GROUP BY
    YEAR(sales_date),
    MONTH(sales_date)
ORDER BY
    sales_year,
    sales_month;


-- products drive revenue

SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM dbo.product_performance
ORDER BY 1;


SELECT COLUMN_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo'
  AND TABLE_NAME = 'product_performance'
ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION;


SELECT TOP 10
    product_id,
    product_name,
    category_name,
    brand,
    total_orders,
    total_units_sold,
    net_sales,
    average_selling_price
FROM dbo.product_performance
ORDER BY net_sales DESC;

-- best-performing categories

SELECT
    category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders,
    SUM(total_units_sold) AS total_units_sold,
    SUM(net_sales) AS total_net_sales
FROM dbo.product_performance
GROUP BY category_name
ORDER BY total_net_sales DESC;



-- Next business case: Regional sales

SELECT
    state,
    SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders,
    SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales
FROM dbo.regional_sales
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY total_sales DESC;




SELECT
    SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders,
    SUM(total_items) AS total_items,
    SUM(net_sales) AS total_net_sales,
    MIN(sales_date) AS first_sales_date,
    MAX(sales_date) AS last_sales_date
FROM dbo.daily_sales;






SELECT 'customer_360' AS table_name, COUNT_BIG(*) AS row_count
FROM dbo.customer_360

UNION ALL

SELECT 'customer_segmentation', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.customer_segmentation

UNION ALL

SELECT 'daily_sales', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.daily_sales

UNION ALL

SELECT 'product_performance', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.product_performance

UNION ALL

SELECT 'regional_sales', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.regional_sales;
